cli.usage:
Usage: grok-companion.mjs <setup|review|adversarial-review|audit|task|imagine> [options] [prompt]
Review: --base <ref> --scope <auto|working-tree|branch> --language <tag> --model <model> --cwd <path> --json
Review scopes auto and working-tree require Windows and fail if a complete safe snapshot cannot be collected.
On macOS/Linux, use --scope branch or --base <ref> for committed changes; uncommitted changes are excluded from the comparison diff, but surrounding files may still be read from the working tree. Use audit for the whole repository.
Task: --model <model> --effort <low|medium|high> --cwd <path> --prompt-file <path> --write --json
Imagine: --model <model> --effort <low|medium|high> --cwd <path> --prompt-file <path> --output <path> --aspect <ratio> --allow-api-billing --json
Each command runs a new foreground Grok session. For resuming, use Grok's own resume command.
cli.disabled: {name} is no longer supported. Use Grok's own commands to resume or manage sessions.
cli.prompt_required: A prompt is required for this Grok run.
cli.unsupported_effort: Unsupported reasoning effort. Use low, medium, or high.
setup.update_grok: Update Grok Build with `grok update`, then run setup again.
setup.install_grok: Install Grok Build with `{command}`, then run setup again.
setup.authenticate: Authenticate with `grok login` (or `grok login --device-auth`), or configure XAI_API_KEY, then run setup again.
diag.usage_exhausted: Grok's usage balance is exhausted (HTTP 402). Retry after the balance recovers.
diag.stop_unconfirmed: Grok agent stop could not be confirmed.
diag.turn_incomplete: Grok turn did not complete (status: {status}, stop reason: {stopReason}).
diag.permission_denied: Permission requests denied in this run: {count}
render.stopped_before_result: Review incomplete; Grok stopped before returning a final structured result.
render.invalid_json: Grok did not return valid structured JSON.
render.unexpected_shape: Grok returned JSON with an unexpected review shape.
render.incomplete_notice: Review incomplete; this result must not be treated as approval.
render.no_verified_findings: No verified findings; inspection is incomplete.
diag.image_entitlement: Grok Build's image tools are not available for this sign-in. The account reported that these tools need a SuperGrok subscription. On The X Subscription, Imagine uses the shared weekly usage pool; with an xAI API key, re-run with --allow-api-billing only if you accept per-image API billing.
imagine.api_billing_required: Image generation with XAI_API_KEY is billed at xAI API rates ({model} is listed from {price}), not from the subscription usage pool. Re-run with --allow-api-billing to continue.
imagine.api_billing_notice: API key sign-in: image generation is billed at xAI API rates ({model} is listed from {price}), not from the subscription usage pool.
imagine.subscription_pool: Subscription sign-in: image generation draws from the account's shared weekly usage pool, not per-image API billing.
imagine.no_image: Grok did not return a generated image from its session images directory.
imagine.untrusted_path: Refused to copy a reported image path outside Grok's session images directory.
imagine.copy_failed: Could not copy the generated image: {detail}.
imagine.partial_copy: Saved {saved} image(s), then stopped copying the rest: {detail}
imagine.output_escapes: The output path must stay inside the workspace: {path}.
imagine.output_unusable: The output path is not a usable directory: {path}.
imagine.bad_aspect: Unsupported aspect ratio: {ratio}. Use one of {ratios}.
imagine.no_repo_write: imagine does not edit the repository. It only copies generated images into the output directory.
imagine.extension_mismatch: The output extension {output} does not match the generated image extension {source}. The bytes are not converted, so the extension is left unchanged.
err.grok_missing_agent_stdio: This Grok Build version does not expose `grok agent stdio`. Update it with `grok update`, then rerun `/grok:setup`.
err.grok_not_installed: Grok Build is not installed. Install it with `{windows}` (Windows) or `{unix}`, then rerun `/grok:setup`.
err.git_not_a_repository: This command must run inside a Git repository.
err.git_not_installed: git is not installed. Install Git and retry.
err.git_cwd_unavailable: Unable to start Git: the working directory is unavailable.
err.git_too_old: Git 2.45 or newer with --no-lazy-fetch support is required for read-only operations. Update Git and retry; automatic fetching remains disabled.
err.git_base_with_repo_scope: --base does not apply to --scope repo. A repository audit reviews the whole source, not a diff.
err.git_unsupported_scope: Unsupported review scope "{scope}". Use one of: auto, working-tree, branch, repo, or pass --base <ref>.
err.git_default_branch_undetected_win: Unable to detect the repository default branch. Pass --base <ref> or use --scope working-tree (requires a complete safe snapshot).
err.git_default_branch_undetected: Unable to detect the repository default branch. Pass --base <ref> to review committed changes; uncommitted changes are excluded from the comparison diff, but surrounding files may still be read from the working tree. Use a repository audit to review the whole source.
